output.population: 197 patients with pathologically confirmed resected colorectal liver metastases and preoperative portal venous contrast-enhanced MDCT within 6 weeks of hepatic resection; those with 90-day mortality or under 24 months follow-up excluded.
output.summary: Preoperative contrast-enhanced CT images with DICOM segmentation objects and survival data from a single-institution consecutive series of patients who underwent resection of colorectal liver metastases, for quantitative image analysis.
